text:
"Young Man from Phayao, Young Woman from Isaan" is a restaurant serving delicious food in generous portions at a clean location.
The owners are very friendly. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great place to eat, especially their amazing Pad Krapow (stir-fried basil with meat). It's rich, flavorful, and satisfying – you can order it spicy to your liking!
